purpose: Canonical self-contained register schema and unconfirmed starter templates; not a completed research plan or scientific approval.
instructions: Create only the records needed by the current interview phase. When running the checker, all five JSON files must exist; copy each files entry into its named file, not this whole asset.

All five inputs share one nonempty current version string. Preserve stable unique IDs across registers, unknowns and change records. IDs begin with a letter and contain only letters, digits, underscore, dot, colon or hyphen, at most 64 characters.

Add completed record_templates to the appropriate records array. Do not count empty prototypes as substantive records. The plan register is flat: every plan record has its exact record_type. Optional extra domain fields are not inferred as hidden rules.
Record actual USER replies and their scope. ANSWER, delegation, a preselected option or silence never becomes CONFIRM. G1-G3 confirmation is distinct from AUTHORIZE_EXECUTION.

Optional state.changes records permit explicit carry-forward. Each GATE_CHANGE has id, from_version, to_version, reason, source, affected_gate_ids, preserved_gate_ids, affected_constraint_ids and preserved_constraint_ids. Its gate arrays disjointly partition G1-G3. Constraint arrays contain explicit disjoint CONSTRAINT IDs; G1 preservation does not automatically preserve any constraint.

Changes form one unambiguous complete chain ending at state.version. An older gate or constraint USER/CONFIRM remains applicable only if every intervening change explicitly preserves that exact decision ID. Retain its original version and original user source. Affected decisions must be INVALIDATED or genuinely reconfirmed; no silent retagging is allowed.

A changes.source may describe actual user changes or ASSISTANT refinements within an already approved boundary. It records why existing consent remains applicable and never creates a new confirmation or evidence claim. Source authenticity and unchangedness require semantic review.

Budget rows cover every explicit config_ids item used by TRAINING, ANALYSIS, EVALUATION or PROFILING tasks, once per aggregate maximum-run configuration. Missing coverage is an error. Unconfigured evaluation/profiling costs need review. budget_total_hours is null when relevant coverage or duration is incomplete.

Unknown forecasts use null bounds, UNKNOWN, a rationale in basis and a registered future PROFILING task in profile_task_id. They may be execution prerequisites; explicitly CRITICAL_SCIENTIFIC forecasts block READY. No GPU, hardware model or training task is mandatory for clinical analysis.

group_ids, if supplied, are observed pseudonymous identifiers in one comparable namespace. Leave null or omit when unavailable; missing IDs do not prove independence. Never ship patient identifiers in the global skill.

available_inputs and required_inference_inputs are exact project-defined modality or variable names. Required method inputs must be a subset of every linked dataset available_inputs; no semantic alias matching is performed.

READY requires applicable genuine G1-G3 USER/CONFIRM records, HANDOFF stage, readable nonempty registered session, main_plan and review artifacts, substantive records and all required sections. Artifact defaults are session.md, project-plan.md and review.md. Explicit CRITICAL_SCIENTIFIC UNKNOWN, CONFLICTED or PROVISIONAL blocks READY. A hypothesis awaiting experiment may be PROVISIONAL with a noncritical impact when its feasibility is established.

A PASS reports explicit registered structure only. It cannot authenticate sources, confirmations, change scope, scientific adequacy, main-document consistency, independence or real resource feasibility. It never advances state or executes command text.

Optional state.artifacts maps session, main_plan and review to custom relative .md paths; omitted roles use default names. Absolute/root/drive paths, any .. traversal, non-.md files and symlink/junction escape are rejected. Registered custom artifacts remain protected against forced report overwrite. Artifact existence does not validate its scientific content.

schema_dialect.type: object, array, string, integer (not boolean), number (finite, not boolean), boolean, or null
schema_dialect.properties: Known object fields and their schemas.
schema_dialect.required: Every listed object key must exist; missing fields, invalid types/enums, NaN/Infinity or duplicate JSON keys give exit 2.
schema_dialect.additional_properties: Extra domain fields are allowed, but no hidden relationship or scientific check is inferred from them.
schema_dialect.items: Schema applied to every array item.
schema_dialect.min_length: A value of 1 rejects empty or whitespace-only identifier strings.
schema_dialect.any_of: Either null or the single documented non-null schema.
schema_dialect.conditional_variants: Each plan record is additionally checked against schema.record_variants[record_type]; each non-null constraint validation uses schema.validation_variants[rule_type].

foreign_keys.experiment.task_ids / task.depends_on /: TASK IDs; an unknown budget profile target must have kind PROFILING.
foreign_keys.constraint.validation.target_ids: IDs of the explicit QUANTITY rule record_type. Unique valid IDs count; duplicates never inflate a quantity.
CONSTRAINT IDs. Exact explicit preservation is required to carry each old confirmation; constraint scopes must be disjoint.
foreign_keys.change.affected_gate_ids / change.preser: Exact G1/G2/G3 values. These arrays disjointly partition all three gates for every version transition.

report_contract.optional_derived_field: budget_total_hours is runs-times-duration over registered budget rows, or null if duration or relevant task configuration coverage is incomplete. budget_config_coverage records required_ids, covered_ids, missing_ids, unconfigured_task_ids and complete. These fields do not prove complete real computation costs.

exit_codes.0: Explicit registered structure passes. Scientific review remains.
exit_codes.2: Input, JSON, schema or output operational error.

report_contract.output_policy: Inputs and default/custom registered project artifacts remain read-only. Reject report destinations aliasing protected inputs, including symlinks/hardlinks. Existing reports require --force. Publish an atomic UTF-8 report; failure preserves existing inputs and reports.

limitations: A PASS means explicit registered structure passes; it does not establish scientific validity or readiness of real execution resources.
Submitted USER/CONFIRM provenance cannot be authenticated by this checker; inspect the actual user reply and its scope in the registered session artifact.

GATE_CHANGE records only register continued applicability of original consent; their source, unchanged scope, and affected/preserved decisions require semantic review and cannot create new confirmation.
No source authenticity, literature novelty, label quality, clinical value, statistical adequacy, or real resource feasibility is scientifically validated.
Observed group IDs are compared only within their submitted namespace; missing identifiers and different identifier encodings do not prove independence.
No natural-language inference, semantic word matching, network access, command execution, data analysis, or training is performed.
